Training load dataframe with rest days

Source: R/training_load_rest.R
training_load_rest.Rd

A dataframe with the training load of 3 subjects over 8 weeks, with rest days. Subject 1 trains 4 days per week; subject 2 trains 5 days per week with a double session on Wednesdays and does not train in week 5; subject 3 trains 3 days per week and 6 days in the last week. Created with simulated data (see data-raw/training_load_rest.R in the source code).

Usage

data("training_load_rest", package = "ACWR")

Format

A data frame with 101 rows (one per session) and 5 variables:

ID

ID of the subjects

Week

training week

Day

calendar day since the start (1 = Monday 3 January 2022)

TL

training load (arbitrary units)

Training_Date

training date (Date)
